title: NGS Library Prep for Targeted Sequencing of DNA Methylation Patterns in Cell-Free DNA: Step 4 of 5: PCR 2
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare PCR2 mixes with plate primers
steps.instruction: For each PCR plate, assemble a PCR2 master mix that contains the plate‑specific forward primer (the forward primer is included in the PCR2 mix). Use a separate tube of PCR2 mix for each plate so that each plate receives its unique forward primer.

steps.title: Add template and barcoded primers
steps.instruction: Distribute the PCR1 product (output from step 2) into each well of the PCR plates, then add the appropriate PCR2 mix. Finally, add the well‑specific barcoded reverse primer (unique for each well; there are two barcode plates providing a total of 192 distinct reverse primers).

substeps.instruction: Transfer the PCR1 product into each well.
Add the plate‑specific PCR2 mix containing the forward primer.
Add the well‑specific barcoded reverse primer.

steps.title: Pause for manual intervention
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol; the OT‑2 deck lights will signal the pause. Perform any required manual steps before proceeding to the next part (pooling).
